## Government Repository Submission

Thanks for contributing to the GovTech dataset! Please fill in the checklist below before submitting.

### Submission checklist

- [ ] My file is in `submissions/pending/` and named `<country-code>-<org-name>.yaml` (e.g. `gb-nhs-digital.yaml`)
- [ ] I copied from `submissions/TEMPLATE.yaml` and filled in all required fields
- [ ] The `org` field matches the exact GitHub org/user login
- [ ] The `country` field is a valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code
- [ ] I've included at least one `evidence` link to an authoritative source confirming this is a real government entity
- [ ] I've checked that this org isn't already in the [government.github.com registry](https://github.com/github/government.github.com/blob/gh-pages/_data/governments.yml) or in `submissions/pending/`

### About this organisation

**GitHub org:** <!-- e.g. github.com/nhs-digital -->
**Country:** <!-- e.g. United Kingdom (GB) -->
**Why it's missing:** <!-- e.g. new agency, wasn't in the upstream registry, etc. -->

### Evidence of government status

<!-- Paste links here as well as in the YAML — makes it easier for reviewers to check without opening the file -->
